subject: Operations
title: Quantum Computing for Operations
description: A micro-lesson that makes Quantum Computing for Operations usable.

hook.text: A logistics firm has 1 million possible routes. A classical computer takes days. A quantum computer: minutes.

buildup.text: Quantum computing processes complex optimization problems exponentially faster than classical computers.

discovery.text: Operations problems like route optimization, scheduling, and supply chain simulation are ideal quantum use cases.

twist.text: Quantum computers are still experimental. Practical, commercial use in operations is 5–10 years away at best.

climax.text: Volkswagen tested quantum route optimization for 26 buses and reduced wait times. Small scale, huge potential.

punchline.text: Quantum is coming. It will reshape optimization forever.

quiz.question: What operations problem can quantum computing solve faster?
options: Complex optimization like routing and scheduling
